new_jobs.description:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai . Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn , X , Instagram , and YouTube .

Job Description:

The Senior Technical Project Manager – Enterprise Technology & Systems Delivery is a project delivery leader within the PMO organization responsible for managing technology programs and enterprise transformation initiatives across multiple workstreams. This role drives delivery from initiation through go-live and stabilization, ensuring tight schedule management, strong cross-functional coordination, proactive risk and issue escalation, and disciplined governance throughout the project lifecycle.

The role requires someone who can understand technical concepts, dependencies, and delivery risks well enough to coordinate effectively across engineering, infrastructure, integration, data, and testing teams, but who is not expected to serve as the hands-on technical lead or provide technical solution ownership. Success is defined by on-time execution, stakeholder alignment, effective governance, and sustainable adoption of technology-enabled change.

What you'll do:

Lead end-to-end project management for technology implementations, platform migrations, system integrations, and transformation initiatives from charter through go-live and hypercare.
Manage multiple concurrent workstreams, integrating business, engineering, infrastructure, data, testing, and change activities into a single executable project plan.
Build and maintain detailed schedules, milestone plans, RAID logs, dependency trackers, RACI matrices, and status reporting.
Coordinate closely with business stakeholders, IT and engineering teams, systems integrators, and vendor partners to ensure alignment on scope, timing, deliverables, and decisions.
Facilitate planning, requirements, design, and workstream checkpoint sessions with technical leads and business process owners.
Support governance routines, including workstream meetings, status reviews, and escalation paths; help prepare materials for steering committees and leadership updates.
Identify, track, and escalate risks, issues, decisions, and dependencies through the project governance structure with urgency and clarity.
Ensure the project schedule is actively managed and tightly driven, including follow-up on overdue actions, management of critical path items, and resolution of cross-workstream blockers.
Coordinate technical and non-technical delivery activities across integrations, infrastructure, data migration, testing, cutover, and deployment, without acting as the technical authority for solution design.
Support budget tracking, forecast updates, and variance reporting where applicable.
Lead preparation for SIT, UAT, cutover, and go-live readiness activities in partnership with the appropriate SMEs and delivery leads.
Support organizational change management, communications, training coordination, and adoption planning with business and OCM partners.
Track vendor and systems integrator delivery performance against plans and milestones.
Prepare clear status updates, decision summaries, and risk reports for project leadership.

Required qualifications:

3+ years of project management experience, including 2+ years leading technology implementation or integration projects.
Demonstrated experience managing technical programs (e.g., software platform implementations, infrastructure or cloud migrations, system integrations, or enterprise application rollouts).
Ability to manage multiple workstreams simultaneously while maintaining a tightly controlled integrated schedule and clear accountability across teams.
Solid understanding of technology delivery lifecycles, including planning, design, build, test, data migration, cutover, go-live, and stabilization.
Ability to understand technical concepts, integration dependencies, environment readiness, data migration risks, and testing implications sufficiently to coordinate teams and drive delivery, without being the primary technical resource.
Strong command of project management fundamentals including scope management, schedule management, RAID management, dependency tracking, status reporting, and governance.
Experience working with stakeholders across business, IT, and vendor organizations.
Excellent communication, facilitation, and organizational skills, with the ability to drive action and elevate issues clearly and promptly.
CAPM, PMP, or equivalent certification is a plus.

Preferred qualifications:

Experience within a PMO or technology delivery team supporting cross-functional programs.
Experience managing technical workstreams across domains such as cloud infrastructure, data & analytics, DevOps/engineering, cybersecurity, or digital/customer platforms.
Background in technology transformation, including migration from legacy platforms and coordination of business process change.
Exposure to enterprise governance practices, such as steering committee reporting and structured escalation management.
Familiarity with organizational change management frameworks and enterprise adoption planning.
Prior experience as a business analyst, technical lead, or systems power user is helpful, particularly where that experience improves communication with technical and business teams.

This is a hybrid role with a mix of remote and in-office working as part of Fidelity’s dynamic working arrangement.

Current work authorization for Canada is required for all openings.

Who We Are

Fidelity Investments is a world leader in mutual funds and ETF management. We pride ourselves in proprietary and disciplined research-driven investing. We offer a complete line of products and services to investors through a network of third-party brokers and financial advisors. Our primary goal is to support investment professionals as they endeavor to prepare their clients’ retirement and other significant life goals which demand focused financial management.

The role

The Project Manager (PM) is responsible to lead teams within a complex matrix environment to the successful completion of projects in support of multiple business lines, cross-functional in impact and are typically technical in nature. Depending on the type of project, it may follow the waterfall or agile methodology.

The PM is also accountable for the project team’s effectiveness by enabling the Agile methodologies to improve its practices within its frameworks.

How You’ll Make an Impact
Prepares project charter and develop detailed project plans including detailed scope statements, schedule and budget estimates and baselines, resource plans, quality plans and success criteria.
Completes all required project governance gates approval forms and presentations.
Establishes project communications and monitoring and control mechanisms.
Manages day to day project activities ensuring deliverables are met, risks are identified and assessed, and issues are managed and resolved.
Leads project team(s) in a matrix environment, clarifying roles & responsibilities, providing individual direction and feedback, and ensuring required communication support is in place.
Partners with the Project Management Office to ensure portfolio, program and project management standards, processes and procedures are adhered to.
Implements and utilizes reporting and control mechanisms, and in particular project change management approaches, to ensure the project’s triple constraints (time, cost, performance scope and quality) are well managed and status and issues are reported to sponsors, executive sponsors and senior management on a timely basis.
Ensures project post implementation reviews are planned and executed in compliance with Fidelity standards.
Works with vendors, industry firms and internal Fidelity business units to explore innovative business solutions with new technologies and alternative processes.
Participates in the preparation of RFPs, evaluate proposals, statements of work and select vendors.
In conjunction with internal partners, participate in meetings and act as the central point of contact to manage tasks, relationships, and deliverables during the lifecycle of the project.
Clear and concise Product goal definition and backlog items that the Project Team can easily understand and act upon.
Address impediments related to unclear backlog items or changing scope.
Facilitate stakeholder collaboration across business and technology teams.
Periodic advisory and coaching of the organization on Agile methodologies.
Continuous improvement reviews of the organization’s effectiveness at adopting Agile methodologies.
Ongoing support and the removal of barriers between stakeholders and Project Teams.
Periodic reporting of Project Team performance through well-defined Key Performance Indicators (e.g. burn-down / burn-up charts, velocity, etc.), value generation, and taking into consideration feedback from the Project Team, Business Owner, and key stakeholders.

In-depth knowledge of Project Management and Agile frameworks, principles, and processes
Strong coaching and leadership skills.
Team focused with ability to teach teams how to be self-organized.

Comfortable working with multiple teams.

Ability to work with cross divisional teams, senior management, and internal and external stakeholders.

new_jobs.title: S&OP Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
Job Description:

Are you a self-starting transformation driver, strategic thinker and pragmatic deliverer
, who turns a long-term vision and complex objectives into step-by-step reality and a clear path forward? Do you possess strong project management skills
with the ability to translate a multi-year roadmap into smaller bricks and actionable wins, keeping momentum high as requirements evolve? Are you a gifted communicator
who breaks down silos and unites cross-functional teams around a lean way of working? Do you possess the business acumen and analytical skills to spot risks and interdependencies across projects and complex organizations? If so, join us as S&OP Project Manager!

What The Job Is ...

We have embarked on a multi-year, enterprise-wide transformation program through 2030 to support the long-term growth and industrialization of Satair and Airbus Material Services. We are redesigning the Processes, Methods, Tools and Data (PMTD) across various domains and organizations, for a lean operating model powered by a Fit-to-Standard modern ERP and harmonized processes.

One of the key cornerstones of this transformation is the deployment of an integrated end-to-end Sales and Operations Planning process across various businesses.

In your position as S&OP Project Manager you will be part of a cross-functional and cross-organizational project team. In addition to designing and implementing the TO BE S&OP Processes, Methods, Tools and Data (PMTD), you will act as the key point between our external consultancy partners, internal business stakeholders and the broader enterprise transformation program.

Travel required: 15%

How you will contribute to the team:

PMTD and Architecture Design and Implementation: Design the target Process, Method, Tools and Data covering customer demand, supply capacity and feedback loop mechanisms, including scenario-planning and escalation protocols across and between businesses. Partner with IT and Digital to define the future ERP requirements for S&OP, ensuring a seamless and integrated architecture between Processes and Tools.
Project Management: Define project roadmap, translate long-term ambition into short-term milestones, maintain project governance, ensure progress towards deliverables, identify and proactively manage interdependencies and risks.
Stakeholder Alignment Beyond Silos: Proactively identify and engage senior stakeholders across functions and organizations in a complex environment to drive alignment on future ways of working, overcome organizational friction and secure global process simplification and standardization.
Consultant Management: Lead the relationship with external consultants, steering their deliverables to shape our target S&OP Processes, Methods, Tools and Data (PMTD). Validate consultant proposals and recommendations against business needs and context, ensuring designs are scalable and implementable across various business units.
Strategic Escalations & Executive Briefings: Prepare executive-ready decks, high-impact decision dossiers, trade-off analysis, recommendations and progress updates for executive forums and the central Transformation steering.
ERP Fit-to-Standard (F2S): Drive business readiness and stakeholder participation across multi-functional teams for F2S workshops to design the future ERP requirements. Safeguard S&OP scope requirements within the central ERP system, ensuring seamless alignment between S&OP process and the future ERP capabilities.
Ad-Hoc Initiatives: Lead other potential initiatives or projects related to S&OP.

Candidate Profile & Qualificatio ns

Core experience and background
:

Education: MSc/MA in Business, Economics, Strategy, Finance, Supply Chain or a related field
Experience and Track record: 5-8+ years of experience in Project Management, Supply Chain, Management Consulting or equivalent. Proven track record in project management, S&OP deployment, leading cross-functional teams or enterprise process redesigns.
Methodologies: Mastery of structured project management and business process mapping.
Languages: Fluent English is mandatory. Good command of French or German is a plus.

Work style and soft skills:

You are self-driven, proactive and autonomous
You can translate complex long-term objectives into clear sequential steps. You have a strong focus on driving progress and delivering results, ensuring execution momentum even when requirements change.
You can balance strategic thinking with tactical execution
You are analytical, and enjoy understanding the intricacies of how things work
You are excellent at stakeholder management and can navigate large organizations with ease
You are a natural communicator and consensus builder, with the ability to understand and demystify complex concepts to obtain stakeholder buy-in
You have the ability to influence senior leaders, negotiating trade-offs and overcoming organizational resistance.
You have excellent analytical skills and business acumen, able to translate complex information into clear recommendations

What does your next challenge look like?

At Satair, we believe in sustainable aviation that allows people to travel and connect across the globe.

We are on a mission to provide world class material solutions that keep aircraft flying and extend their lifespan.

In Satair, you can challenge the status quo, pioneer new ways of working, and generate real value for airlines and suppliers worldwide.

Being part of the Airbus family gives us the opportunity to live a global mindset, working in international teams and collaborating across functions, sites and cultures.

If you want to work as one team embracing a can-do attitude in a demanding environment, then we offer a great place to explore, learn, and grow.

Come on board and join us at Satair, an Airbus Services Company!

About SATAIR

Satair offers first class material management solutions in the aftermarket business of the aviation industry. We are working to be the most customer-centric organization in providing commercial aviation spares parts to make the world continue flying. We are constantly taking customer experience to new levels by improving how we fulfill and deliver customers’ orders quickly and accurately, anywhere in the world. To meet this goal, Satair is continually striving to innovate and provide best-in-class service levels by pioneering new products and services in a fast growing business environment.

With our global functional organization spanning across 11 different sites and locations worldwide with more than 1.800 people and a turnover of $3.3 billion, you will be part of a truly global family.

Our customers have the ultimate goal to operate their fleet and our Airbus aircraft safely, efficiently in a cost-time-quality effective manner and of course with the expected comfort level for their customers. We at Satair do everything to support our customers in this.

If you want to know more about our business, have a closer look at our website www.SATAIR.com or check out our SATAIR Youtube Channel at www.youtube.com/sataircompany !

What do we offer at SATAIR?

At SATAIR, you will find much more than a job - we offer you the possibility of growing both your personal and professional capacities in a fun, supportive and informal working environment, where you will be encouraged to engage, share knowledge and ideas.

SATAIR is committed to achieving workforce diversity and creating an inclusive working environment. We love to bring in people with different backgrounds and experiences as we believe it enhances our performance immensely!

Here is a selection of some of the benefits we offer our employees in Copenhagen:

Competitive remuneration, including short term incentive bonus on all levels
Work/life balance: hybrid working, flex time, maternity/paternity/parental leave, 29 days of holiday + senior and flex days
Personal development: personalized development plans, large portfolio of learning solutions and many internal mobility opportunities, both locally and globally
Health and well-being: Health insurance, in-house canteen with many healthy options

Come on board and join us at Satair, an Airbus Services Company

Please send us your CV and application as soon as possible to become part of an exceptional global team! We will be having interviews on an ongoing basis.

We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation or religious belief.

When applying for the position, you accept our data privacy statement: http://www.SATAIR.com/privacy

This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth.

new_jobs.description:
About Pinterest

Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.

Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible.

At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI.

Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here.

Staff Technical Program Manager, Advanced Technology Group

Pinterest Technical Program Managers deliver critical and strategic outcomes by directing and scaling engineering effort across organizational and functional boundaries.

Pinterest is looking for a highly technical, experienced Staff TPM to join the Advanced Technology Group (ATG), a research-driven engineering organization advancing Pinterest's ML/AI capabilities. You'll partner directly with senior product and engineering leaders to turn ambitious AI strategy into shipped, reliable, and widely adopted capabilities. This is a high-visibility role spanning research, ML platform, infrastructure, safety, and product teams.

What You'll Do

Lead complex, multi-workstream programs across ML research, platform engineering, infrastructure, safety/compliance, and product, aligned under one roadmap, metrics, and governance.
Partner closely with the VPs of Product and Engineering to translate strategy into workstreams, staffing, milestones, and clear decision-making.
Drive the path from research to production: model development, evaluation, release management, serving capacity, and adoption by product teams.
Define and track metrics and guardrails (quality, cost, reliability, adoption, cycle time) and use them to drive decisions.
Run technical design and decision forums; identify risks and tradeoffs early and align senior leaders on a path forward.
Build operating mechanisms (planning, reviews, intake, launch readiness, post-mortems) that scale across teams working at different paces.
Use AI tooling to automate tracking, reporting, and program insights.
Communicate status, risks, and decisions to executives and cross-functional partners, tailoring technical depth to the audience.

What We're Looking For

Minimum 8 years in technical program management, engineering, or related roles, with a track record of leading org-level, multi-team ML/AI or platform programs.
Bachelor's degree in a technical field or equivalent practical experience.
Deep technical understanding of ML/AI systems (training and post-training, evaluation, model serving, GPU capacity, release management) and platform engineering. You can read design docs and challenge assumptions.
Experience with LLM/multimodal model adoption, such as adapting open-source models, evaluation frameworks, and migrating workloads between model providers, is a strong plus.
Proven ability to partner with VP and Director-level leaders in Product and Engineering and influence strategy and prioritization.
Experience designing planning processes and governance (annual and multi-half planning) across several organizations.
Strong analytical skills: SQL, dashboards, and using data from experiments and evaluations to drive decisions.
Comfort with high ambiguity, rapidly changing technology, and cross-functional work with Legal, Privacy, and Safety partners.
Exceptional written and verbal communication, including nuanced technical concepts for executive audiences.
Demonstrated ability to build and scale processes, and to use AI tools to automate program management.

In-Office Requirement Statement

We recognize that the ideal environment for work is situational and may differ across departments. What this looks like day-to-day can vary based on the needs of each organization or role.
This role will need to be in the office for in-person collaboration 1-2 times/quarter and therefore can be situated anywhere in the country.

Relocation Statement:

This position is not eligible for relocation assistance. Visit our PinFlex page to learn more about our working model.

At Pinterest we believe the workplace should be equitable, inclusive, and inspiring for every employee. In an effort to provide greater transparency, we are sharing the base salary range for this position. The position is also eligible for equity. Final salary is based on a number of factors including location, travel, relevant prior experience, or particular skills and expertise.

new_jobs.description:
ServiceChannel is the leading cloud-based service automation platform for facilities management. We offer a single platform to source, procure, manage, and pay for repair and maintenance services from commercial contractors. We are a high growth, late-stage startup with fantastic product-market fit, and trusted by more than 500 global brands like Cole Haan, Bloomin’ Brands, CVS Health, Louis Vuitton, Allbirds, and Under Armour. We are committed to creating a great product for our customers

and a great work environment for our employees to succeed professionally and personally, landing us on Wealthfront's Career-Launching Companies List for the second year in a row.

ServiceChannel is seeking an experienced Project Manager to join our Marketplaces team. Our ideal candidate will bring facilities management expertise and a proven track record of driving successful projects from initiation through completion. This role has significant visibility and responsibility, serving as the external face of ServiceChannel to strategic accounts while working closely with senior leaders across the organization. The Marketplaces Project Manager will help advance ServiceChannel’s mission by strengthening partnerships, managing the optimization of provider networks, and ensuring the timely delivery of the contractual ServiceChannel obligations.

Key Responsibilities

Apply project management best practices to support the Marketplaces program, including
ServiceChannel Managed, Network Optimization, and other strategic accounts.
Partner cross-functionally with Sales, Implementation, Facility Services, Strategic Sourcing, Provider Development, and Operations to align project deliverables with customer expectations.
Collect and analyze key customer information to enable successful program execution.
Support compliance and legal configuration processes by identifying contractual or operational nuances.
Review customer data and recommend provider, system, or trade optimization strategies.
Participate in and document customer and implementation meetings, building trusted partnerships and capturing insights to source the best-fit providers.
Maintain accurate project tracking, databases, and reports to monitor milestones and measure success across implementation, sourcing, and onboarding.
Track and report customer health, status, and progress toward team objectives.
Synthesize and share client insights across internal stakeholders to drive alignment.
Prepare and present data and recommendations to clients and internal teams.
Identify gaps in provider coverage and collaborate with sourcing and operations to address needs for new locations or trades.
Lead comprehensive issue list and trade consultations to improve service delivery and customer experience.
Manage and complete additional projects that positively impact Marketplaces, Operations, and other cross-functional teams.
Leverage data insights to identify trends, measure impact, and recommend process improvements.

Required Skills & Experience

3+ years of project management experience.
Proven ability to manage complex programs with shifting priorities.
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills to address complex business challenges.
Exceptional professionalism, communication, and conflict resolution skills.
Ability to influence stakeholders and drive decisions through clear, persuasive communication.
Skilled in negotiation and building productive relationships.
Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment with high attention to detail and quality.
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain Management, or related field.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, including advanced Excel skills.

Preferred Skills & Experience

Experience in facilities management strongly preferred.
Experience with ServiceChannel software or similar CMMS solutions.
Ability to balance and advocate effectively for internal stakeholders, providers, and clients.
Strong data analysis skills, with the ability to interpret and translate insights into actionable recommendations.
Detail-oriented, adaptable, and solution-driven mindset.
Highly motivated self-starter with a collaborative, positive team attitude.
Creative thinker with a passion for continuous improvement.

Fortive's essential technology makes the world safer and more productive. We accelerate transformation in high-impact fields like workplace safety, build environments, and healthcare.

Our forward-looking companies lead the way in healthcare sterilization, industrial safety, predictive maintenance, and other mission-critical solutions. We're a force for progress, working alongside our customers and partners to solve challenges on a global scale, from workplace safety in the most demanding conditions to advanced technologies that help providers focus on exceptional patient care.

We are a diverse team 10,000 strong, united by a dynamic, inclusive culture and energized by limitless learning and growth. We use the proven Fortive Business System (FBS) to accelerate our positive impact.

At Fortive, we believe in you. We believe in your potential—your ability to learn, grow, and make a difference.

At Fortive, we believe in us. We believe in the power of people working together to solve problems no one could solve alone.

Amazon Web Services is looking for an Infrastructure Technical Program Manager to support and deploy one of the world’s largest and most complex telecommunication networks. The role is responsible for the execution of a strategic plan to improve the business processes and deployment of hyper-scaled cloud infrastructure, creation of a quality control system for North and South America (NASA), pre/post-inspections for design validation, and piloting stakeholder communication for delivery schedules. This opportunity is within the Global Connectivity Infrastructure Delivery - Fiber Deployment organization, which is responsible for project management, quality and delivery of fiber capacity for the physical network solutions that drive Amazon’s internal infrastructure and connect our services to the world.

Key job responsibilities

Reports to the GCID-FD Deployment Manager, and updates regularly with Global Senior management.

Serve as a key member of the GCID-FD team helping to drive overall Network Infrastructure strategy.
Vendor management to deploy on time, measure progress, and rate through quality Key performance Indicators.
Develop a focused quality management program that tracks defects, mitigates risks, standardizes root cause analysis, and implements key performance measures to rate vendor success.
Create and standardize reporting mechanisms for the GCID-FD group and provide regular progress updates on program deployment to management and stakeholders.
Periodically report on the overall network development program status across the assigned region.
Manage and track deployment of approved network plans with internal customers and stakeholders such as technical business developers or construction vendors until the infrastructure is in service.
Manage multiple competing cross-functional projects/programs simultaneously, some on a global scale.
Interact with engineers, technicians, vendors and senior management on a daily basis
Physically audit completed construction work, review fiber test results, and hand-off completed delivery to internal customers
Run meetings, create and maintain timelines, and keep large, diverse groups informed of progress and obstacles.

Coordinate access and approvals to security-regulated sites

25-40% Travel

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. HII Mission Technologies is seeking a Business Operations Manager to provide remote operational, administrative, and financial support to the STINGRAI program. The Business Operations Manager will provide comprehensive administrative, operational, and financial support to the STINGRAI Program Manager and cross-functional teams. This role manages day‑to‑day business processes, coordinates project and resource activities, oversees financial reporting and subcontractor management, and serves as a key liaison with internal departments including accounting, legal, HR, and the Program Support Office (PSO). Provide day-to-day management of administration and operational tasks under the direction of the STINGRAI Program Manager.
Manage day-to-day internal business processes across functional departments.

new_jobs.description:
NVIDIA is building the future of real-time graphics and cloud-native experiences through GeForce NOW (GFN) and Graphics Delivery Network (GDN). As a Technical Program Manager (TPM) on this team, you will lead highly cross-functional and technically complex programs. You’ll manage infrastructure, GPU-based streaming, partner integrations, operational readiness, and low-latency, high-fidelity delivery of gaming and interactive applications globally.

You will partner with engineering, product, operations, security, and external ecosystem partners to deliver reliable, globally distributed cloud services. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in highly technical environments, excels at execution difficulty, and is motivated by building and scaling world-class cloud services.

What You’ll Be Doing

Own the full lifecycle of large-scale, multi-phase technical programs for both GFN and GDN – from conceptualization through requirements, develop, launch, and iteration.
Work closely with Engineering (infrastructure, backend, client), Product, Data Center Operations, SRE, Capacity Planning, QA, and Partner teams (games publishers and app developers).
Define clear, actionable technical requirements that align with product goals.
Establish and maintain SLIs/SLOs/SLAs, incident response plans, and operational playbooks for a 24/7 global service.
Identify technical and program-level risks (capacity, latency, partner dependencies), propose mitigations, and drive decision-making with collaborators.
Liaise with game publishers, app creators, and external engineering teams; help integrate their build pipelines into NVIDIA’s streaming infrastructure.
Plan and implement launches (new features, new regions, capacity expansions) with cross-team alignment; lead launch readiness reviews.
Drive process improvements across product delivery, streaming performance, operational efficiency, and partner workflows.
Communicate program health, risks, tradeoffs, and decisions to senior leadership with transparency and data-backed insights.

What We Need To See

15 + proven experience in Technical Program Management, Program Management, Engineering Management, similar technical leadership roles, or equivalent experience - ideally in cloud, infrastructure, streaming, or graphics. Bachelors or Graduate degree coupled with a PMP is preferred, or equivalent experience.
Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, real-time streaming services, engineering.
Extensive experience delivering sophisticated, multi-team programs with cross-functional collaborators.
Experience with cloud-native systems (microservices, Kubernetes, observability stacks, CI/CD, API driven services).
Ability to translate product direction into actionable technical plans with well-defined requirements.
Excellent communication, conflict resolution, and participant management skills; ability to influence engineering, product, and business partners.
Experience with operational frameworks such as SLIs/SLOs/SLAs, incident response, NPI readiness, high-level availability, and service reliability.
Strong analytical and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams in a fast-paced environment.
Familiarity with game streaming (GFN) or graphics delivery networks (GDN) is highly desirable.
Comfortable working within Agile or other program management frameworks; experience writing SRDs, PRDs, RFCs, operational plans, etc.

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

Experience in cloud gaming, real-time media streaming, or consumer-scale cloud services.
Familiarity with AI/ML deployment pipelines, inference optimization, or GPU-based compute stacks.
Deep background in data center operations, edge compute, capacity planning, or multi-region service scaling.
Security and compliance program experience (SOC2, ISO 27001, cloud governance, GDPR).
Experience managing global partner integrations with ISVs, OEMs, CSPs, or game publishers. A Passion for gaming and understanding of the GeForce NOW ecosystem.

new_jobs.description:
Description

Do you want to drive large-scale programs that deliver measurable infrastructure optimization and peak readiness across hundreds of services powering hundreds of millions of Amazon devices? Do you want to use AI to scale your impact and automate program execution along the way? If so, we want to talk to you.

The Devices Software and Services (DS2) team is seeking a Senior Technical Program Manager to lead large-scale, highly visible programs that span every Devices product line and demand cross-org influence at the executive level. These programs are Memory Optimization and Peak Readiness. Memory Optimization reduces memory consumption across Devices fleets through code optimization, JVM tuning, instance-family migration, and rightsizing, using AI to surface candidates from fleet telemetry and accelerate the analysis-to-action cycle. Peak Readiness is the cross-Devices Q4 Peak program covering service scaling, resiliency testing, operational readiness campaigns, and coordinated game days across hundreds of services, using AI to scale beyond manual coordination and automate execution.

DS2 owns the platform layer beneath every Kindle, Echo, Fire TV, and Fire Tablet sold worldwide. We own device identity, registration, OTA updates, telemetry, cloud-to-device messaging, and lifecycle management for hundreds of millions of devices. As the horizontal organization across the Devices portfolio, DS2 also leads flagship programs spanning multiple product lines, including infrastructure optimization and efficiency, next-gen authentication implementations, and software regulatory compliance.

Excellent oral and written communication skills, with strong analytical and problem-solving skills

Well-developed organizational skills and a successful track record of coordinating between multiple project stakeholders, TPMs, and software development teams

Foster a culture of candor and respect, facilitating communication at all levels

Effective negotiation skills; able to make smart trade-offs (e.g., time vs. effort vs. cost), drive appropriate schedules, and readjust priorities to ensure the right customer, technology, and engineering outcomes

Ability to deliver results and balance short-term goals against long-term outcomes

Deliver high-priority and high-visibility goals spanning multiple organizations

Drive monthly and quarterly business reviews and provide program updates to leaders 3 levels above

Influence organization roadmap priorities and technical direction

Represent difficult trade-off decisions and solutions clearly to leaders up to 3 levels above, helping them understand options

Manage cross-functional and cross-organization communication to keep stakeholders informed and aligned

Guide technical direction and decisions to deliver solutions that meet Amazon's high standards for customer satisfaction, efficiency, stability, scalability, simplicity, and operational excellence

Basic Qualifications

7+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
5+ years of technical product or program management experience
3+ years of software development experience
Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules

5+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules
Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership

new_jobs.description:
Job Type

Full-time

Description

Fermi America is seeking a Data Center Project Manager to assume single-point accountability for delivering all data center buildings associated with an assigned tenant account.

This role owns the outcome across the account—including scope, cost, schedule, quality, and the commercial position with the delivery partner—from the release of each building through commissioning and turnover to operations. This is an owner-side delivery role, not a coordination role. The Data Center Project Manager directs Fermi’s position with the design-build or construction partner executing the work. This individual makes and defends decisions with significant capital and schedule consequences.

Leadership holds this person accountable when a building is late or over budget. The Project Manager also serves as Fermi’s delivery representative to the tenant and is responsible for the credibility of Fermi’s commitments and reporting. The position exists to provide each tenant account with a dedicated delivery owner. The Director of DC Construction governs partner relationships, contracting strategy, and delivery standards across the portfolio, while the Data Center Project Manager is accountable for delivering the assigned account. As additional tenants join the campus, the number of Project Managers will scale with the number of tenant accounts rather than the number of buildings.

This role reports to the Director of DC Construction and works closely with the DC Senior Technical Specialist, DC QA/QC and Commissioning, project controls, Procurement and Sourcing, safety, facility operations, and the tenant’s project team.

When a DC Construction Manager is assigned to the account, the Data Center Project Manager establishes that role’s day-to-day field priorities. The DC Construction Manager will continue to report to the Director of DC Construction. The Project Manager does not direct verification findings, progress confirmation, or maintenance of the field record. Those responsibilities remain independent of the cost and schedule position reported by the Project Manager.

The assigned scope may include buildings delivered through lump-sum turnkey, design-build, construction management at risk, or multiple-prime contracting structures. It may also include concurrent and sequential builds within the same tenant account.

Key Responsibilities

Serve as the single point of accountability for all buildings within the assigned tenant account throughout the complete delivery lifecycle, including design development, procurement, construction, commissioning, and turnover to operations.
Own sequencing and prioritization across concurrent and successive buildings within the account, including the allocation of shared resources, contractor capacity, long-lead equipment, and campus infrastructure.
Drive standardization and repeatability across the account by applying design packages, contracting terms, and execution approaches proven on earlier buildings, enabling each successive release to be delivered faster and with less variance.
Manage interfaces with shared campus infrastructure serving multiple buildings within the account, including power interconnection, water, connectivity, and common site work.
Develop and maintain the project execution plan, including the contracting approach, alignment of work and cost breakdown structures, organization and interface plan, risk register, and turnover strategy.
Establish and defend the project baseline for scope, cost, and schedule. Control deviations through a formal change-management process.
Administer the delivery agreement as Fermi’s representative, including notice obligations, milestone certification, pay-application recommendations, retention, and liquidated-damages provisions.
Lead the evaluation, negotiation, and disposition of change orders. Substantiate entitlement and quantum positions while defending Fermi against unsupported cost and time claims.
Direct Fermi’s review of design deliverables against the approved basis of design in coordination with the DC Senior Technical Specialist, who retains technical authority.
Own the cost forecast and monthly variance analysis across the account, working with project controls to produce estimate-to-complete and estimate-at-completion positions by building and in aggregate.
Own the milestone position and schedule outcome across the account, working with the DC Scheduler to validate contractor schedules and quantify the effects of changes and delays on each building and the account as a whole.
Drive interface definition and closure across power interconnection, connectivity, tenant fit-out, campus infrastructure, and adjacent construction.
When a building is delivered as a powered shell, assume responsibility for the commercial consequences of changes to the base-building and tenant fit-out demarcation, including pricing, entitlement, and schedule impacts. Definition of the boundary remains the responsibility of the DC Senior Design Integration Manager.
Drive systems-completion and turnover planning, including system-boundary definition, mechanical-completion walkdowns, punch-list management, and turnover-package acceptance.
Support commissioning through Level 4 and Level 5 testing and IT load delivery. Validate that demonstrated performance meets contractual requirements before acceptance.
Coordinate handover to facility operations, including spare parts, training, as-built documentation, and warranty transfer.
Own the tenant relationship for delivery matters associated with the assigned account, including scope, schedule, technical resolution, and reporting. Protect Fermi’s position while maintaining a productive relationship throughout a multiyear, multi-building program.
Support Procurement in bid-package development, technical and commercial evaluations, and partner selection for the assigned scope.
Establish and enforce the safety standard for the assigned scope, holding the partner accountable to Fermi requirements and applicable regulations without exception.
Deliver decision-grade reporting to leadership concerning cost, schedule, risk, and required decisions so that leadership is never surprised.

AI-Enabled Execution Philosophy

Fermi America Integrates Artificial Intelligence And Advanced Analytics Into Its Core Project-delivery Workflows. The Data Center Project Manager Will Be Expected To Embrace And Champion This Philosophy By

Using AI-assisted cost and schedule analytics to test the credibility of contractor forecasts and identify differences between reported and actual performance.
Leveraging AI-driven benchmarking against completed buildings to validate pricing, durations, and change-order positions.
Applying AI-assisted document and contract analysis to support change-order evaluation, entitlement assessment, and claims defense.
Deploying automated reporting so that project status is assembled from source systems rather than compiled manually.
Using predictive analysis of procurement, delivery, and installation data to identify threats to milestone dates before they materialize.
Incorporating delivery outcomes and lessons learned into Fermi’s execution standards so that each successive building can be delivered faster and with less variance.

Requirements

Relevant Experience

15+ years of experience in construction or project delivery, including at least eight years working on data centers, mission-critical facilities, or comparable complex, MEP-intensive programs.
Demonstrated single-point accountability for at least one building or asset delivered from contract award through commissioning and turnover, with documented performance against the sanctioned baseline.
Experience delivering multiple buildings or assets concurrently for a single customer or account, including making sequencing decisions, allocating shared resources, and managing the cumulative customer relationship throughout a multiyear program.
Strong command of major contract structures—including lump-sum turnkey, design-build, construction management at risk, guaranteed maximum price, and multiple-prime arrangements—and an understanding of how owner exposure differs among them.
Proven success in change-order negotiation, entitlement assessment, and claims defense on large capital projects.
Strong knowledge of data center scope, including shell and core, MEP systems, critical power, cooling and direct-liquid cooling, controls, and IT infrastructure, as well as how design decisions affect construction and operations.
Experience owning a project cost forecast and presenting and defending variances to executive leadership.
Working knowledge of schedule development and analysis in Oracle Primavera P6, with sufficient expertise to critically assess a contractor’s schedule rather than accept it at face value.
Experience leading commissioning and turnover to operations, including accepting demonstrated performance against contractual requirements.
Owner-side experience with a developer, operator, or end user, in addition to any contractor-side experience.
Excellent executive communication skills, with the ability to present positions to leadership, lenders, and customers clearly and precisely.
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, or a related field. Project Management Professional (PMP) certification is preferred.

Preferred Qualifications

Direct delivery experience on hyperscale data center programs for major technology companies or leading data center developers.
Experience delivering successive buildings using a repeatable playbook, including standardized design packages and framework agreements.
Experience with high-density and liquid-cooled deployments and their effects on construction sequencing and commissioning.
Familiarity with Oracle Primavera P6, Oracle Primavera Unifier, and Oracle Aconex—or equivalent enterprise project-delivery systems.
Experience managing owner-furnished equipment under an owner-managed delivery model.
Experience supporting project-financing workstreams, including lender and independent-engineer due diligence and drawdown substantiation.
Comfort working in a high-growth organization where this role will help define delivery standards as the campus expands.

Work Requirements

This is a 100% on-site position based at Fermi’s campus in Amarillo, Texas, with periodic travel to vendor facilities, fabrication shops, and partner offices as needed.
Ability to work on active construction sites, including walking job sites, climbing ladders, and navigating unfinished structures in varying weather conditions.
Willingness to wear all required personal protective equipment (PPE), including a hard hat, safety glasses, high-visibility vest, steel-toe boots, and hearing protection.
Flexibility to work extended hours during critical construction milestones, commissioning events, and schedule-recovery efforts as needed.

Job Summary

The ARMS Program Manager administers and oversees the Armament Retooling & Manufacturing Support (ARMS) Program at Hawthorne Army Depot on behalf of the General Manager. The position is responsible for developing and managing commercial-use initiatives, tenant agreements, business development activities, regulatory compliance requirements, financial tracking and reporting, program marketing, and strategic utilization of government-owned facilities and assets. This position exercises independent judgment in coordinating cross-functional stakeholders, evaluating commercialization opportunities, preparing and administering Tenant Use Agreements (TUAs) and Requests for Use of Facilities (RUFs), maintaining ARMS program records and financial data, and ensuring compliance with Army, Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR), contractual, environmental, safety, and operational requirements.

Responsibilities

Administer and manage the Armament Retooling & Manufacturing Support (ARMS) Program at HWAD on behalf of the General Manager. Develop, implement, and oversee program activities, priorities, policies, reporting requirements, and strategic initiatives to ensure compliance with ARMS legislation, Federal Acquisition Regulations (FAR), contract requirements, and Army objectives. Serve as the primary point of contact for ARMS-related matters involving government representatives, tenants, commercial partners, and internal stakeholders. Maintain the ARMS CDRL and deliverable matrix and coordinates preparation, quality review, and timely submission of required CDRLs.
Develop, administer, and maintain Tenant Use Agreements (TUAs), Requests for Use of Facilities (RUFs), contract modifications, renewals, and supporting documentation. Coordinate cross-functional reviews involving safety, environmental, operational, legal, engineering, and business personnel to ensure commercial-use activities comply with applicable regulatory, contractual, and installation requirements.
Manage ARMS program records, financial data, and performance metrics, including revenue, consideration, Facility Contractor Account (FCA) activity, jobs created, critical skills retention, economic impact, and benefits to the Army. Analyze program data and prepare recurring and annual validations, execution plans, and management briefings for Company and Government leadership.
Identify, evaluate, market, and support commercialization opportunities that increase utilization of government-owned facilities and assets while supporting Army readiness objectives. Conduct outreach with prospective tenants, commercial entities, government agencies, economic development stakeholders and community partners to promote sustainable business growth, economic development, workforce retention, and revenue generation. Create and maintain a qualified tenant/opportunity pipeline documenting ARMS benefits and supporting project scoring packages.
Lead and coordinate ARMS program planning activities, tenant meetings, audits, inspections, corrective actions, and compliance reviews. Monitor agreement performance, address operational issues, evaluate risks, and recommend solutions that support program objectives and long-term sustainability.
Research, develop, and prepare proposals, special studies, business cases, strategic initiatives, and program recommendations, to include the development of FCA and PAA funded projects. Prepare candidate project descriptions, estimated costs, benefits, tenant impacts, funding source assumptions and prioritized FY/outyear project lists. Exercise independent judgment in analyzing information, evaluating alternatives, and providing recommendations to executive leadership regarding commercialization opportunities, program improvements, asset utilization, and compliance matters.

KSAs (Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities)

Working knowledge of the Armament Retooling & Manufacturing Support program at HWAD sufficient to administer program activities and support required reporting.
Compliance knowledge related to Company, government, contract, lease, and program requirements applicable to ARMS and commercial-use activities.
Data tracking and reporting capability sufficient to maintain records for costs, revenues, critical skills, jobs created, Army benefits, and assigned program measures.
Business communication capability sufficient to coordinate with internal teams, designated customers, tenants, managers, supervisors, and external stakeholders.
Contract and proposal support capability sufficient to comprehend, analyze, document, and support lease agreements, ARMS proposals, and assigned special projects.
Software proficiency sufficient to use Microsoft Office and related business systems to complete tracking, reporting, documentation, and communication requirements.

3+ years of experience in planning, procedure writing, budget preparation, regulatory compliance, project scheduling, contract coordination, commercialization, business operations, or related administrative program support. Required

Working closely with Information Security, Cloud Engineering, Technology Risk, Compliance, Audit, and business stakeholders, you'll help translate complex security and control requirements into actionable remediation plans, strengthen accountability, and provide clear reporting to senior leadership.

What You'll Do

Drive Cloud Hardening & Security Remediation: Coordinate cloud security hardening initiatives, track remediation of security vulnerabilities and control gaps, and work with Cloud Engineering and Information Security teams to ensure remediation activities align with enterprise security standards and risk requirements.
Manage Remediation Governance: Develop and maintain enterprise remediation plans, milestone schedules, management action plans, risk and issue registers, dependency trackers, and commitment logs supporting internal audits, regulatory reviews, and technology risk programs.
Coordinate Evidence & Audit Readiness: Oversee evidence collection, quality reviews, approvals, and submission processes, ensuring remediation outcomes are appropriately documented, traceable, and ready for audit, risk, compliance, or regulatory assessment.
Deliver Executive Reporting & Insights: Produce dashboards, scorecards, governance presentations, and concise executive updates highlighting remediation progress, cloud security risks, milestone performance, blockers, and decisions requiring escalation.
Strengthen Controls & Stakeholder Accountability: Facilitate cross-functional governance forums, maintain RACI models, process documentation, and decision records, and support consistent ownership, escalation, and closure-readiness practices across remediation workstreams.

7+ years of relevant experience in business analysis, technology governance, security remediation, risk management, audit support, regulatory compliance, or enterprise remediation programs, ideally within complex financial services environments.

Hands-on experience in rigging and theatrical drapery installation is a plus but is not required for this role. This is a hands-on, leadership position that requires frequent travel to themed entertainment and music related job sites across the United States. Typical duties include leading the installation and programming of architectural and stage lighting controls to support new build and renovation projects. Travel is a major part of this job, and day rates are provided for qualifying travel work. We are looking for someone with a leadership attitude with a strong technical background who enjoys working with their hands, solving problems, and joining a growing team. If you enjoy leading a team on-site, travelling, and seeing projects come to life, this position is perfect for you.

Job Summary

The Integration Project Manager will work with clients to develop and manage lighting, rigging and drapery solutions, including equipment and services. They will oversee projects from system concept to realization, ensuring customer expectations & objectives are met throughout the project and beyond. They work with architects, designers, construction trades, and end users to meet contractual requirements and expectations for Integrations Projects.

Job Responsibilities And Requirements

Understands, abides by, and instills the philosophy, policies, and procedures of Bandit Lites.

Self-motivated, proactive, results oriented professional with an ability to work independently or as part of a team.

At Azenta, new ideas, new technologies and new ways of thinking are driving our future. Our customer focused culture encourages employees to embrace innovation and challenge the status quo with novel thinking and collaborative work relationships.

All we accomplish is grounded in our core values of Customer Focus, Achievement, Accountability, Teamwork, Employee Value and Integrity

Job Title

Senior Program Manager, SRS

Job Description

Azenta Life Sciences is a market leader in automated bio sample management solutions and multiomics services across areas such as drug development, clinical and advanced cell therapies for the industry's top pharmaceutical, biotech, academic and healthcare institutions globally. Within Azenta, the Sample Repository Services (SRS) business provides industry-leading biobanking, sample storage, logistics, laboratory services, and specimen management solutions that help customers safeguard and maximize the value of their critical biological materials.

How You’ll Add Value

The SRS Senior Program Manager provides strategic leadership technology-enabled initiatives across SRS r. This role leads complex, cross-functional programs designed to modernize repository processes, improve operational efficiency and accuracy, increase scalability, and enhance the customer experience.

Serving as a key connection between Repository Operations, Informatics, Quality, Engineering, Commercial, and other business functions, the Senior Program Manager translates operational and customer needs into executable programs. The successful candidate will combine strong program management capabilities with an understanding of customer needs, repository operations, automation, Lean methodologies, process improvement, and change management to deliver sustainable solutions that support the continued growth and evolution of SRS.

What You’ll Do

Lead programs from concept through implementation, ensuring alignment with business objectives, operational requirements, timelines, budgets, quality standards, and customer expectations.
Develop and maintain comprehensive program plans, including milestones, resources, dependencies, risks, budgets, and implementation requirements.
Partner with Repository Operations and business leaders to identify opportunities for process improvements , reductions in operational complexity, improve accuracy, and increased scalability.
Apply Lean principles and tools—including value-stream mapping, process mapping, standard work, visual management, root-cause analysis, Kaizen, and mistake-proofing—to eliminate waste, streamline repository workflows, and improve safety, quality, delivery, cost, and productivity.
Translate business and operational needs into clearly defined functional and system requirements in partnership with operations, Informatics, Engineering, Quality, and other stakeholders.
Coordinate cross-functional teams to evaluate, prioritize, test, validate, and implement new technologies and process enhancements.
Establish program governance, including project schedules, milestones, risk management, issue resolution, change control, and executive-level status reporting.
Proactively identify program risks, dependencies, and barriers and drive mitigation plans and timely escalation when needed.
Ensure automation and technology changes are appropriately tested and validated prior to implementation.
Partner with Quality and operational stakeholders to ensure new processes and technologies align with applicable quality systems, SOPs, work instructions, and regulatory requirements.
Develop implementation and change-management strategies that support successful adoption of new technologies and processes across repository teams.
Facilitate cross-functional Lean workshops and Kaizen events, using data and performance metrics to establish baselines, prioritize improvements, measure results, and sustain gains through standard work and leader accountability.
Partner with business leaders and stakeholders to define functional requirements, features, priorities, and delivery timelines for technology-enabled solutions.
Build strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders and maintain clear, consistent communication regarding program progress, risks, decisions, and outcomes.
Support the development of strategic roadmaps that enable SRS growth, operational excellence, and scalability.

What You’ll Bring

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Operations, Life Sciences, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
7+ years of progressive experience in program management, product management, project management, operations, automation, technology implementation, or a related discipline.
Demonstrated experience leading complex, cross-functional programs from planning through implementation.
Experience with automation, laboratory operations, repository/biobank operations, life sciences, or other highly controlled operational environments preferred.
Strong understanding of program and project management methodologies, including risk management, change control, resource planning, and stakeholder management.
Demonstrated ability to translate business and operational requirements into technology or automation solutions.
Experience working with software, laboratory informatics, LIMS, inventory management systems, or related platforms preferred.
Experience operating within regulated life sciences, pharmaceutical, clinical, or laboratory environments preferred.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify root causes and develop sustainable solutions.
Demonstrated experience applying Lean methodologies and tools—such as value-stream mapping, process mapping, Kaizen, standard work, visual management, root-cause analysis, and mistake-proofing—to deliver measurable and sustainable operational improvements.
Excellent written, verbal, and executive-level communication skills.
Demonstrated ability to lead through influence and effectively manage stakeholders within a global, matrixed organization.
PMP, PgMP, Lean/Six Sigma, Agile, or comparable certification preferred.

ButterflyMX is on a mission to empower people to automate property access, operations, and security from a single platform. Our products are installed in more than 20,000+ multifamily, commercial, gated communities, and student-housing properties worldwide, including properties developed, owned, and managed by the most trusted names in real estate. Our features are designed for developers, owners, property managers, and tenants and our products lower operating costs and improve tenant satisfaction .

Our Solution

Developers and owners no longer need to run building wiring or install in-unit hardware. Property managers can grant building access, revoke permissions, and review entry logs from an online dashboard. Residents can open doors from their smartphones, issue visitor access, and see who is trying to enter the building.

Our Culture & Values

Fantastic people are the key to our success. As a distributed, primarily remote workforce, we’re looking for more intelligent, passionate, collaborative, ai-forward, and down-to-earth individuals to join our growing team. We’re driven by a shared commitment to excellence and innovation, grounded in our core values: We delight our customers, We take ownership, We are a community of collaborators, We speak up, We think big and do small, and We are tenacious.

We are looking for a self-motivated Project Manager to ensure that key aspects of the client implementation process are completed in a timely and accurate manner. In this role, you will be responsible for coordinating hardware installation and software implementation projects from the start of a new customer signed contract through the final completion. Your goal is to ensure that each project is completed on schedule, that the quality meets all standards, that the projected profit levels are maintained or improved, and that the customer is completely satisfied.

The IPM is the customer's primary project contact and coordinates the people, dates, decisions, and dependencies needed to put the contracted solution into service. and transition to Client Success.

Serve as the primary point of contact for customers and installers throughout the implementation process
Define actionable next steps for customers while involving, aligning and managing relevant stakeholders across teams
Validate deal data with customers to ensure accurate details to set up the project
Maintain implementation project tracking record - update and track project details, status, requests, change orders, payment details on an ongoing basis leveraging our CRM system
Forecast project completion timeframes
Prioritize work queues to ensure projects and communications are progressing
Coordinate hardware installation process and software implementation, including working with internal and external installers, sales teams, CSMs and customers
Manage schedules, activities, and communications with customers and installers
Coordinate invoicing requests and validate billing/payment inquiries
Communicate with internal departments (client success managers, technical teams, finance, and sales teams) and our customer to ensure a smooth and positive client service experience
Stay informed on inventory and tracking of materials needed for projects
Liaise between Sales and Client Success teams to facilitate successful project handoffs

Requirements

1-2 years of relevant work experience in a customer-facing role in project management, customer success or support, or as a project coordinator
Bachelor Degree qualified or equivalent work experience
Demonstrate a high level of accountability for your work
Exceptional documentation and communication skills
Proven track record of delivering results and working towards targets
Prior experience working with email platforms and SFDC
Proven experience with leveraging AI tools in both professional and personal settings. ButterflyMX is an AI-forward organization and the ability to optimize efficiency using AI is crucial in every role.

Compensation

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. About The Role

The Cyber Threat Analysis Division (DS/CTI/CTAD) conducts advanced digital technical forensic analysis and application assessments to support Department of State information, systems, and personnel. Within this division, the Mobile Threat Analysis (MTA) section serves as the primary capability for identifying and mitigating security anomalies within the mobile ecosystem.

The team leverages a wide variety of advanced technologies to perform comprehensive forensic examinations and deep-dive mobile app assessments, ensuring the detection of malicious behaviors, unauthorized data exfiltration, and emerging attack vectors. By synthesizing complex mobile telemetry and forensic artifacts, the team provides actionable intelligence and mitigation strategies to stakeholders worldwide, ensuring the integrity of the Department's mobile environment against sophisticated global threats.

In this role, you will:

Conduct forensic examinations of mobile devices (e.g., Android and iOS phones), including full physical, logical, and file-system acquisitions.
Perform mobile application assessments to analyze behavior, identifying malicious code, unauthorized data exfiltration, privacy risks, and communication patterns within installed applications.
Perform consolidated and comprehensive information and intelligence analysis of mobile threat data obtained from classified, proprietary, and open-source resources to provide awareness to relevant stakeholders.
Analyze and report on unique attack vectors, emerging cyber threats, and current trends used by malicious actors targeting mobile ecosystems.
Assess the cyber threat environment for U.S. missions worldwide.
Ensure that forensic community accepted principles and practices are applied throughout the entire lifecycle of the analysis.
Utilize industry-accepted forensic tools to perform analysis, including but not limited to Cellebrite, Magnet, and other commercial and open-source forensic and app-analysis software.
Collaborate with other forensic analysts, law enforcement officers, and legal experts to identify and recommend methods and procedures for recovery, preservation, analysis, and presentation of digital evidence.
Travel to domestic and overseas locations to provide operational briefings and threat awareness.
